posts.title: The Social Singularity
posts.description: The days of internet hobbyists and hackers is gone---or so I am told, for I never experienced it. In its place lies humankind's most insidious creation. A wasteland devoid of authenticity and diversity. A desert, save for a few oases who attract all but the most curious. These oases need the people they attract to stay thirsty--as their shareholders pay top rates for the more people they have--so
